art_request: Art Request 12: The Wilderness Scenes, at Night

images.selection_reason: Broad clear frost-grass landing field with four corner stakes; fully visible plank bridge and clear right exit.
Large ancient hollow tree, distinct standing-stone clearing, and uninterrupted left-to-right earth path; root-swallowed arch stays clear of the main route.
Clear left-to-right broken flagstone road; cairns are stacked stones with no copied crystal nodes; distinct ruined hut and frozen tarn.
